violated_contract: A client-controlled query parameter embedded into outbound URLs - HTML form actions, hrefs, hidden input values, JSON payload fields consumed as links, and redirect targets - must be percent-encoded at the embedding site: a raw value containing a double quote breaks out of the HTML attribute (reflected XSS on an unauthenticated page) and a bare '&' or '#' corrupts the query handed to the next hop. Seven remaining plugin apps (dropbox, google-calendar, hive, ms365, shipbob, shopify, linear) embedded uid raw after the apps fixed in #13658 and #14350 were hardened (issue #14350 class).
canonical_prevention: Compute the encoded value once per handler (urllib.parse.quote, safe='') and use it at every outbound-URL interpolation, HTML-escape value/text contexts, and pin each app with a manifest-registered hermetic suite that drives the real handlers through a hostile uid asserting percent-encoding and intact attributes and links.
